purpose: Immutable release-candidate snapshot fixing N20V2-F01: real execution of N20_PROVIDER_TRANSPORT against implementation.graph.v5.yaml (the rc3-approved, rc5-schema-corrected active graph) reached a genuine, well-evidenced BLOCKED because rules.retired_provider_test_scan.scan_roots (['tests/runtime'], walked recursively) caught 16 real occurrences of "gemini" in tests/runtime/test_gemini.py and tests/runtime/test_capabilities.py -- two files that test a wholly separate, still-active Plan 11/19/20/21 Gemini pipeline this migration does not own and no node in this graph owns. implementation.graph.v6.yaml fixes this by dropping both files from N20_PROVIDER_TRANSPORT's write set and narrowing retired_provider_test_scan.scan_roots to the explicit, exact union of every migration-owned active test file across N20-N60 (17 files), replacing the directory walk. This is a mechanical write-set/scan-scope engineering correction, not a specification or provider decision, and does not touch N20's own real, independently-verified production implementation.

corrects_prior_generation_finding.finding_title: N20's node-scoped scan_node.py --node N20_PROVIDER_TRANSPORT fails on two test files unrelated to this migration
corrects_prior_generation_finding.note: This is not a correction of a prior FAILED release candidate (rc1-rc5 are all preserved exactly as they were, and rc3/rc5 both reached QA_PASSED / chain_valid true and remain the user-approved package-structure lineage). It is a correction of the graph itself, discovered only once N20 was actually, genuinely executed for real against rc5's approved graph -- N20's own real production code (transport.py, egress.py, model_nodes.py, config/model_jobs.v1.yaml, policy/routes.v1.yaml, policy/routing/model_registry.v1.yaml, and their schemas) is untouched by this correction and remains exactly as N20 built it.
